$comment: Team-shared Claude Code settings — check into git. Personal overrides: .claude/settings.local.json (add to .gitignore). Docs: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings

permissions.$comment: Allow: safe/read-only + your verified project commands. Ask: irreversible or public-facing. Deny: secrets and destructive ops. Replace <placeholders> with your real commands via /onboard.

hooks.$comment: Hooks are deterministic — unlike CLAUDE.md rules, they ALWAYS run. Two templates below. To activate: remove the '_disabled_' prefix and replace the echo with your real command. (1) PostToolUse: auto-lint/format after every edit. (2) Stop: a verification gate — a non-zero exit blocks Claude from ending the turn until the check passes (auto-overridden after 8 consecutive blocks).

hooks.command: echo 'REPLACE: e.g. npx prettier --write "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" && npx eslint --fix "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS"'
echo 'REPLACE: e.g. pnpm typecheck && pnpm test --changed'
